# DIRECTION — 03-passage-console

## Design thesis
Passage Log Console is a make-slot desk, not a boutique shelf: open on the primary product with trade facts on the plate edge; primary argument is material truth + “log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes).” — never lifestyle hero; ban consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome.

## Subject grounding
Subject: Passage Log Console
Audience: harbour masters logging vessel passages.
Primary action: log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes).
Brand palette cues: near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber for warnings only
Anti-references: consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome; consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome.

## Hierarchy
1) primary subject object plate recognition 2) evidence facts 3) choice control (grade/size if evidenced) 4) log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes). 5) secondary SKUs — no fake ★/testimonials

## Signature
Make-slot control on Passage Log Console — primary CTA is the product, not a hero slogan

## Primary risk
Must not drift into banned tropes (consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome; consumer fintech gradie); signature may overfit if evidence is thin.
